retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the killing of a Judiciary Police officer, Jorge Augusto de Carvalho, by the Brigadas Revolucionárias in Porto on 21 March 1978. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Murder of Jorge Augusto de Carvalho, Porto Judiciary Police officer
summary: Wikidata item Q112073029, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "murder arried out by the Revolutionary Brigades of the PRP on 21 March 1978, in Porto". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
